mechanism: Indomethacin may increase atomoxetine plasma concentrations through CYP2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance; additionally, NSAIDs increase cardiovascular and bleeding risks which are concerns with atomoxetine use.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine adverse effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor); consider alternative analgesic; if combination necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor vital signs and renal function regularly.
